desc.zh: 从前缀余额发现最小块，递归优化内部并证明兄弟块的降序排列。
desc.en: Discover minimal blocks through prefix balance, optimize their interiors, and prove descending sibling order.

complexity: O(n² log n) time; O(n²) auxiliary space (conservative bounds for slicing implementation)

concepts.name: Prefix balance and minimal special blocks
concepts.description: Zero returns locate the boundaries of indecomposable special substrings.

concepts.name: Recursive canonicalization
concepts.description: Optimize the interior, preserve its shell, then sort siblings.

concepts.name: Prefix-free sibling exchange proof
concepts.description: Minimal special blocks justify ordinary descending lexical sorting.
